response.original_title: Drop The Gloves: Canada's Toughest Hockey League
response.overview: The LNAH has been called the toughest league in the world. Whereas the NHL averages around 0.3 fights per game, LNAH audiences are treated to more than four per game, with no shortage of bench-clearing brawls, fan fights, and, of course, poutine.  The LNAH is being pressured to follow the NHL’s lead and finally crack down on fighting.
response.title: Drop The Gloves: Canada's Toughest Hockey League
